# Third-party sources

## lua-5.5.1

Unmodified `src/` of the official Lua 5.5.1 release (MIT license, see `lua-5.5.1/LICENSE`),
without the standalone `lua.c` / `luac.c` programs. Compiled into the Python wheel.

- Source: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.1.tar.gz
- SHA-256 of the tarball: `1c4b4068d67061f2a2231ad2b5422e77acea1487ea9890f6320af614f4373dce`

## python3.10-headers

CPython 3.10 public headers (PSF license), used to build the Lua module against the 3.10
limited API (`Py_LIMITED_API=0x030A0000`) without needing Python at build time.

- `include/`: the header tree of CPython 3.10.8, without `pyconfig.h`.
- `pyconfig/macos/pyconfig.h`: generated by `configure` for 3.10.8 on macOS (64-bit).
- `pyconfig/linux/pyconfig.h`: generated by `configure` for 3.10.12 on 32-bit ARM Linux;
  the word-size dependent `SIZEOF_*` / `ALIGNOF_*` values were replaced with the compiler's
  `__SIZEOF_*__` macros so that the file serves 32- and 64-bit Linux.
- `pyconfig/windows/pyconfig.h`: `PC/pyconfig.h` of 3.10.9.
